title: AMC 8 Practice: Triangle Areas with Two Lines — Where Do They Cross?
description:
AMC 8 practice problem on triangle areas with a midpoint and a 2 to 1 point, solved with same-height triangles and a parallel line. (Level 4 of 5)
Two lines cross inside a triangle of area 60. How big is the shaded piece?
Vantee shows two kid-friendly ways: same-height triangles and one clever parallel line, plus the traps and a new triangle to try.
